categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polymer lithium-ion batteries, focusing on consumer batteries such as those for laptops, tablets, smartphones, wearable devices, drones, and electric tools. The company is also expanding into power and energy storage batteries, including automotive low-voltage lithium batteries, industrial drones, electric motorcycles, and home energy storage systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technology development in polymer soft-pack lithium-ion batteries, including high-temperature battery technology, digital battery electrolyte technology, high energy density materials, fast-charging materials, and high-safety battery materials. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques such as multi-tab winding, central tab process (CTP), automated production lines, and flexible production systems. The R&D approach integrates theoretical modeling, platform development, and product development with strong patent protection and collaboration with leading research institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in laptops (HP, Lenovo, Dell, Apple, Asus, Acer, Microsoft, Amazon), smartphones (Apple, Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor, OPPO, Vivo, Lenovo, ZTE), automotive manufacturers (SAIC, IM Motors, GM, Jaguar Land Rover, Li Auto, Chery, GAC, Geely, Stellantis, Mercedes-Benz, NIO), drone manufacturers (DJI), and energy storage providers. The company serves consumer electronics, automotive low-voltage systems, industrial drones, electric motorcycles, and energy storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases and subsidiaries in Zhuhai, Chongqing, Deyang, and Jiaxing. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, India, Hong Kong, and the United States to enhance global market responsiveness and supply chain integration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhuhai CosMX operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, module and pack assembly, and system integration. It procures raw materials such as cathode, anode, electrolyte, and separators from upstream suppliers and delivers finished battery products directly to OEMs and brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with increased R&D investment (12.64% of revenue in 2024). Strategic R&D focuses include high energy density batteries, fast charging, safety enhancements, solid-state lithium metal batteries, automotive low-voltage lithium batteries, and AI-enabled battery design. It also invests in digitalization, AI-driven defect detection, and new material development, collaborating with top universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-developed and manufactured lithium-ion battery products, including cells, modules, and packs, to global consumer electronics brands and automotive manufacturers. The company also derives income from investment returns and government subsidies related to technology and manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhuhai CosMX is a leading global supplier in the consumer lithium-ion battery segment, ranking first in laptop battery shipments worldwide and second in tablet batteries, with a top-five position in smartphone batteries. It competes with major battery manufacturers such as ATL (Amperex Technology Limited) and others in both consumer and power battery markets. The company is expanding its presence in automotive low-voltage and industrial drone battery markets to strengthen its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.54 billion, a 0.83% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 430 million, up 25.03%. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets around RMB 20.95 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion. Its power and energy storage battery segment grew significantly, with revenue increasing by over 67%. The company has a stable and growing financial profile with a focus on sustainable profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhuhai CosMX emphasizes high-performance, safe, and reliable polymer lithium-ion batteries with advanced proprietary technologies such as multi-tab winding, central tab process, and automated manufacturing. The company offers customized battery solutions with superior energy density, fast charging, and safety features tailored to the evolving needs of consumer electronics and automotive applications. Its integrated global supply chain and strong customer relationships provide competitive advantages in quality, delivery, and innovation.
